_what: re-scoring of existing per-compound predictions; no model or calibration procedure is refitted beyond the deterministic cached shared-constant calls the original producers make

definitions.per_compound_ape: median over matched temperatures of |pred - ref| / ref, in %
definitions.within_2x: per-compound median ratio pred/ref in [0.5, 2]; % of compounds
definitions.median_abs_log10_ratio: NEW, symmetric: median over compounds of |log10(per-compound median ratio)|; 0.301 = a factor of 2
definitions.model_routes: each statistic computed per seed file (seed 0 = target_blind_test.csv, seeds 1-4 = paper/evidence/blind_d2_s{1..4}.csv); reported value = median over the five seeds, seed_range = min-max over them

bootstrap.model_routes: one draw of compound indices is applied to all five seeds jointly; on each resample the per-seed median APE (within-2x share) is computed and the median over seeds taken, so the CI is for the five-seed median that is reported. Chosen over (a) a seed-0 CI, which would bracket a figure the paper does not quote, and (b) bootstrapping per-compound seed medians, whose median is a different statistic from the table's.

ml_shared_in_domain.holdout: leave-one-chemistry-cluster-out (X-site cluster); shared constant refitted on the published calculation pairs without the held-out cluster (shared_constant.shared_cp_without_cluster); in domain = VEC 18 and cubic C1b, not polymorphic

ml_uncorrected_in_domain.holdout: model predictions as made (each seed's blind test holds out the chemistry cluster); no calibration

ml_shared_all.holdout: leave-one-chemistry-cluster-out on every half Heusler in the blind test, no domain screen (the blind test's `cluster` column, as compute_null_baselines)

null_constant_in_domain.holdout: leave-one-chemistry-cluster-out; a single constant kappa: the median of the training clusters' reference rows; contains no compound information; seed-free

null_power_law_in_domain.holdout: leave-one-chemistry-cluster-out; A (T/300)^q fitted on the training clusters' reference rows; contains no compound information; seed-free

published_calc_shared_family_test.holdout: published full calculation x shared constant refitted without the scored compound, on the pairs as they stand in that compound's fold (shared_constant.shared_cp_in_fold); the 31 compounds scored held out on the family arm (compute_deployed_route)
published_calc_shared_family_test.ratio_source: recomputed with compute_deployed_route's own global-arm expressions (the CSV stores ape_global but no global ratio); per-compound APE asserted equal to ape_global, 1e-9

published_calc_family_constant.holdout: published full calculation x family constant fitted leave-one-compound-out within the family (references re-chosen inside the fold, PREREG amendment A)

shared_constant_unseen_family.holdout: leave-one-bonding-family-out on the published calculation pairs; shared constant refitted without the held-out family (test_shared_constant.py, candidate C0)
shared_constant_unseen_family._unavailable: test_shared_constant.py builds the per-compound rows in memory and writes only the summary (paper/evidence/shared_constant_test.json); no per-compound file exists, so the symmetric metric and the CIs are not computed here (recomputing them would rerun the leave-one-family-out fits)
shared_constant_unseen_family.source: paper/evidence/shared_constant_test.json lofo.C0 (the source of the registry key)

paired_in_domain.definition: per seed: per-compound model APE minus null APE (percentage points), its median over compounds, and a paired Wilcoxon on per-compound APE (compute_seed_averaged); reported = median over the five seeds. Negative difference = the model is closer.
paired_in_domain.bootstrap: compounds resampled jointly across seeds, per-seed median difference, median over seeds; same rng rule as the routes
paired_in_domain.holm: Holm step-down over the two nulls, applied to the seed-median Wilcoxon p values; a median of p values is a summary, not itself a p value, so the per-seed Holm maximum is given beside it
